title: About CAS Development — design and build studio in Kyiv
description: CAS Development: design, renovation and construction studio founded in Kyiv in 2016. 150+ projects in Ukraine and abroad, 36-month warranty.
lead: CAS Development is an interior design, renovation and construction studio founded in Kyiv in 2016. It designs interiors, renovates and builds turnkey — from compact apartments to private houses, restaurants and offices.

p: Since 2016 we have completed more than 150 projects in Ukraine and abroad. We do not copy trends: first we understand how you live or work, and then we create the space around that.
Every project starts with a brief and a meeting (in person or by video call) and ends with the handover of the property; when we do the renovation, the same manager runs the project on site.
Furniture and materials come directly from China through our own Ozdoba line: minimum order from $500, delivery 30–60 days.

items.p: We remove the unnecessary and keep the essence. Every detail has its place.
Materials, solutions and contractors proven over the years.
Photo reports every 1–2 weeks and an estimate without hidden items.
No templates: every project reflects a particular person.
The studio’s home base: apartments, houses and commercial spaces with site visits.
Design, renovation, construction and furnishing across the country.
Projects in Spain, France, Germany and Poland: design, project support and furnishing.
Projects in Bali, Turkey (Kitana Beach, Bodrum) and the USA; online design and project support.
Leads every project from the first meeting to handover. Agrees the budget, timeline and key decisions with the client and is responsible for the result.
Prepares the estimate and work schedule, organises crews and material purchasing. Keeps the site on schedule and sends the client photo reports every 1–2 weeks.
Develops the interior concept and style and prepares 3D visualisations. Selects materials, furniture and lighting and writes the specifications the crew works from.
Produces layouts and working drawings: walls, electrics, plumbing and lighting. Prepares specifications for the crew and checks that the work on site follows the project.
Run the crews on site: sequence and quality of work, sign-off of every stage.
Build and install kitchens, wardrobes and custom furniture from the project drawings.
Site surveys, setting out and level control during construction.
3D measurement of spaces and as-built drawings — an accurate base for design and estimates.
Drone photo and video of plots, facades and construction progress for client reports.

sections.h2: CAS Development in brief: frequently asked questions
items: CAS Development is an interior design, renovation and construction studio based in Kyiv, Ukraine, founded in 2016. It handles design projects, apartment and house renovation, house construction, office and commercial fit-outs, and furniture procurement directly from China.
The studio was founded in Kyiv in 2016 by Mykhailo, its founder and CEO.

The office is at 44 Antonovycha St, Kyiv. The studio works in Kyiv and the Kyiv region, takes renovation and construction projects in all regions of Ukraine and in Europe, and has had projects in Bali, Spain, the USA, France, Germany, Poland and Turkey.
How much do CAS Development services cost?

Design projects start at $30/m² (minimum $2 500), turnkey renovation at $550/m² (labour and rough materials), office renovation at $350/m², furnishing at $250/m², and houses at $600/m² for the shell or $1 100/m² turnkey. In Europe prices are about 50% higher. The exact figure is set in the estimate after a site survey.
How many projects has CAS Development completed?

More than 150 projects since 2016: apartments, private houses, restaurants, offices, salons, hotels and resorts. Completed examples include the Tetris Hall apartment, the Monpark restaurant in central Kyiv, the Dolls Salon beauty salon and an office in the Chicago residential complex.
No. Renovation is carried out by three in-house salaried crews matched to different complexity levels and types of work.
What warranty does CAS Development give?
A 36-month warranty on completed works. When CAS does the renovation, the final cost stays within ±5% of the estimate; price, timeline and payment schedule are fixed in the contract.
How do I start a project with CAS Development?
Call +380 97 866 77 55 or message on Telegram — phone consultations are free. Next come the brief, a paid site survey, the estimate and the contract.
